Part A: Wipe & Authorize OEM Unlocking (Crucial First Step)

Required on Fresh Tablets
1
Power OFF the tablet. Hold Power + Volume Down to enter Factory Mode ➔ select Clear Storage (wipes pre-existing MDM state clean).
2
Tablet reboots into Android setup wizard. DO NOT CONNECT TO WI-FI! Choose "Set up offline" or Skip.
3
Open Settings > About tablet ➔ Tap Build number 7 times to enable Developer options.
4
Open Settings > System > Developer options:
  • Toggle "OEM unlocking" to ON (Tap Enable on the prompt).
  • Toggle "USB debugging" to ON.

Part B: Fastboot Flashing

Fastboot Mode
5
Power OFF tablet ➔ Hold Power + Volume Up ➔ Navigate to [Fastboot Mode] with Vol Up, select with Vol Down.
6
Connect the USB-C cable firmly to your computer, then click the flash button below.
WATCH TABLET SCREEN: As soon as the command runs, look at the tablet screen and press Volume Up once to confirm bootloader unlock!

HARDWARE RESCUE

Emergency Recovery Cheat Sheet

Hardwired hardware button shortcuts for recovering any frozen, reboot-looping, or misconfigured Acer One 8 tablet.

CRITICAL FIX

Hard Power Off (Stuck in Loop)

If the tablet keeps restarting and won't shut down:

1. UNPLUG USB CABLE
Power + Vol Up + Vol Down
Hold for 15-20 seconds continuously
Unplugging the cable is mandatory — USB power current triggers immediate automatic reboot on Helio G85.
FIRMWARE FLASH

Enter Fastboot Mode

To access bootloader flashing mode:

From Powered Off State
Power + Volume Up
Release when small boot selection menu appears
Use Vol Up to navigate to [Fastboot Mode], press Vol Down to select.
FACTORY WIPE

Clear Storage (Factory Reset)

To wipe corrupt data or pre-existing MDM state:

Factory Mode
Power + Volume Down
Hold until MediaTek factory menu appears
Select Clear Storage to format data partition cleanly.
